scope.notes: Covers the Dragon-Blooded core Charm trees, Five Glorious Dragon Paths/Immaculate Martial Arts, the new Charms in all five Aspect Books, and the Terrestrial/Emerald Circle sorcery represented in the supplied core/sorcery books. Necromancy, Celestial/Solar Circle sorcery, Infernal-only access, and unprovided splatbook-only material are outside the standard catalog.

rulesNotes: Dragon-Blooded standard sorcery access is Terrestrial/Emerald Circle only and requires the Terrestrial Circle Sorcery Charm (Occult 3, Essence 3).
Spells inherit Occult 3, Essence 3, and Terrestrial Circle Sorcery as application-level prerequisites because First Edition spells generally do not present Charm-style minimum fields individually.
Entries with OCR damage or missing fields are retained and explicitly flagged rather than silently guessed.
